FeedMod.Floor.name: feedFloor
FeedMod.Floor.comment: Lowest value the feed modifier can reach.

FeedMod.Ceiling.name: feedCeiling
FeedMod.Ceiling.comment: Highest value the feed modifier can reach.

FeedMod.GrowthPerDay.name: feedGrowthPerDay
FeedMod.GrowthPerDay.comment: Feed modifier gained per in-game day with a qualifying feeding action.

FeedMod.DecayPerDay.name: feedDecayPerDay
FeedMod.DecayPerDay.comment: Feed modifier lost per in-game day without a qualifying action, after the grace period.

FeedMod.GoodWeightThreshold.name: feedGoodWeightThreshold
FeedMod.GoodWeightThreshold.comment: Weight fraction (0-1) at or above which the feed modifier is treated as 'good'.

FeedMod.OkWeightThreshold.name: feedOkWeightThreshold
FeedMod.OkWeightThreshold.comment: Weight fraction (0-1) at or above which the feed modifier is treated as 'ok'.

InteractMod.Floor.name: interactFloor
InteractMod.Floor.comment: Lowest value the interact modifier can reach.

InteractMod.Ceiling.name: interactCeiling
InteractMod.Ceiling.comment: Highest value the interact modifier can reach.

InteractMod.GrowthPerDay.name: interactGrowthPerDay
InteractMod.GrowthPerDay.comment: Interact modifier gained per in-game day with a qualifying interaction.

InteractMod.DecayPerDay.name: interactDecayPerDay
InteractMod.DecayPerDay.comment: Interact modifier lost per in-game day without a qualifying action, after the grace period.

InteractMod.GraceDays.name: interactGraceDays
InteractMod.GraceDays.comment: In-game days after the last qualifying interaction before decay starts.

InteractMod.generationDecayMultiplier.name: interactgenerationDecayMultiplier
InteractMod.generationDecayMultiplier.comment: Multiplier for extra grace days per animal generation.
